title: SB882 (2023 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2023/bills/SB882_.HTM; sha256 e1ccb3356bb98147d8866593557e15318795e932688a2df7e68cd929731a4faf)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced (as filed). Text is identical to the other year of the biennium apart from the heading. SECTION 1 raises classroom instruction from four to fourteen hours (the sentence runs across struck "four", so it is not quoted; quoted lines are the added course topics). SECTION 2 also requires spouse/adult contact names, minors in the home, four character references and a three-year social media account list (items B-F, not quoted for length). No passage vote is recorded; later amendments are not in the text read.
